# Sadhguru Allegations: what the records say
> Fact check of allegations against Sadhguru and Isha Foundation, by Sashank, a volunteer with Isha Foundation. Not an official Isha publication. Each page states the claim, then the court, police or government record, and names any document that is not yet public.
